race.comment: LINE OF LAW (7) finished third on resumption over 1000m at this track. Goes well here and strips fitter now. Top three contender. CASSIMIR (2) finished fourth last start over 1100m at Goulburn after racing on the pace for much of the way. Will take some beating despite drawing out in this easier race. MARYLAND BRIDGE (8) was easily accounted for when fifth last start over 1000m at Geurie. Assess on the good first-up win at Cobar. Worth plenty of thought. NOTLEANORMEAN (10) gets the winkers applied and goes into the exotics. BOBBY'S SECRET (1) did well to finish third when resuming over 900m at Wellington on September 15 last start. Can contest for a place.
